actions.action: Cut broken stem 1 cm below a node and trim dried tip
Place cutting in glass of water with node submerged in bright indirect light
Pot rooted cutting in moist well-draining potting mix once roots are 1-2 inches
Insert bamboo cane/stake and loosely tie sagging stems with soft plant tie
Remove ties once plant is stronger
Group with other plants or set up pebble tray with water for humidity

reason: The answer identifies the broken Maranta stem as a cutting that can root from a node and leads with the same fix as the thread: put it in water and change the water weekly; nothing it adds is harmful.
